name: SOC-005: Windows Malicious Code Execution
description: Detects malicious code execution on Windows including Encoded PowerShell commands, hidden execution flags, LOLBin exploitation (mshta, regsvr32), and TCP socket connections.
aql_expression: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%Windows%' AND (payload ILIKE '%-EncodedCommand%' OR payload ILIKE '%-enc%' OR payload ILIKE '%Bypass%-WindowStyle%Hidden%' OR payload ILIKE '%mshta.exe%' OR payload ILIKE '%regsvr32%/s%/u%' OR payload ILIKE '%Net.Sockets.TCPClient%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
